slot_change_request: HBM-SU3 10-17 -> H-DIE: sucore_<q> r5 is 216x216 (was 330.48^2): ~10k flops instead of ~77k; faces unchanged (W slice, E channel, N clocks); clk_rf[63:0] entries removed; HBM-QCORE6 10-18: 280.8^2 (route r5-ff9f9da83 EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION: GRT 20,000 markers flat; H overflow in the channels between/under the two SRAMs (no H layer over a macro: M2-M4 OBS, M6 zero), V over the macro rows; the 8 kept per-sector writer copies clump at the E face and each spans the die because the sector banks are spread); PD 0.32 so the cells use the area; SRAM B moved to (86.4,172.8) -> 88.6 um middle channel; pin ranges scaled x1.3 (<=2.6 pins/um), clk/rst at the N centre

pin_regs.reason: The RF read commands, relay writers and COLL writer are captured raw at the pins (the hub bank rung moved to the pin); reducer command, slice/SFU operands and drain decode land in clk_ctl registers; every output is a flop. A wrapper stage would add an edge to the fixed n+1 commit / n+3 read / E+11 scalar calendar.

structural_change: HBM-SU3 10-17 qcore r5 (coordinator 0dc): ot_hbm_su_static_qcore_r5 replaces the 66-root qcore (64 per-bank clk_rf + ctl + red; codex hbm_qcore_s_pinrung_r2, 76k FF on 330.48^2). One RF copy (8,192 flops) instead of six per-reader replicas, and only the selected word per read class is registered (raw k+1, rd k+2) instead of a raw/read_data register per (bank, reader) + bank-select mux: ~11.5k flops, ONE root clk_ctl (reducer SRAMs on it; g1 gate: clk_red reached SRAM clock pins, CTS refused a separate root). Read: per-sector word at k+1 from a per-sector address copy, sector select at k+2 (g1: 8,192-load address nets). Pins first (raw command/writer capture at k, decode after the flop). Same edges: commit k+1, rf_bword/rf_dsec k+3, scalar E+11; write-conflict FAULT +1 edge; invalid-read output words are don't-care (documented). Reducer SRAMs stacked on the 43.2 lattice; die faces kept (W slice, E channel, N clocks). Re-home: H-DIE-R7b/R8b grants put sucore_<q> beside its pgslices. g3 (HBM-SU6 10-17, g2 gate: rf_bcmd[*] 8,193 loads = synthesis merged the per-sector read-address copies with the rf_bcmd output flop; placement reg->reg -178.7 ps into mem D): every replicated pin-rung copy is a kept instance (keep_hierarchy ot_hbm_su_qcore_r5_kq): read address per (sector, class, 16-bit half), class 5 per (word slot, half), writer wv/wa/wd/rrv/rra per sector (8 banks each). Same edges; slice_x stays raw (a pin flop would move the E+1 operand edge).
